<MethodEndpoint

  path={'/v1/admin/workflows/{workflowId}/steps/{stepName}/connector'}
  context={'endpoint'}

Replaces the authored primary connector's id on every stored version of the family that declares the step; config, field mapping, retry and fallbacks are untouched. The adapter is validated against each non-retired version, and the first to refuse it names itself in `workflowVersion`. Onboardings already parked on the step finish with the provider they started on. The response projects the slot from the highest published version. The write is audited under the operator the token identifies.
